Pinion Push.name: Pinion Push
Pinion Push.description: The user sweeps one wing forward and drives a short, feather-shedding gust across a room into a target within a few strides. It deals force damage and knocks the target back a step while clearing smoke and dust along the line; held back, it only shoves them off balance without harm. It reaches half the range of a pure wind user's gust and grounds the user for that beat. Strain: light.
